naming_convention: title 必须保留原包名（英文代码名）以便识别；中文名以全角括号附加在包名之后。description 按语言直接替换为精炼文案。
mechanism: DSH readPluginMeta() 读 <pkg>/locale/en.json（英语资源，定义同目录语言文件集合）的 meta.title/meta.description；缺失才回落 package.json.name/description。路径经包 specifier 解析，故 exports 必须导出 ./locale/*。

en.title: dsh-better-sidebar
en.description: File tree, editor, changes, tasks and side chat in one right column, separate per conversation. UI only — it does not change model capability.

zh.title: dsh-better-sidebar（增强侧边栏）
zh.description: 右侧栏提供文件树、编辑器、文件变动、任务与侧边对话，每个会话独立。仅改变界面，不改变模型能力。

en.title: dsh-context
en.description: Context insight and management: dashboard, browser, dynamics and the /context command. Read-only analysis — it does not rewrite session content.

zh.title: dsh-context（上下文洞察）
zh.description: 上下文洞察与管理：仪表盘、上下文浏览器、上下文动态与 /context 命令，看清上下文的构成与演变。只做分析，不改写会话内容。

en.title: dsh-free-search
en.description: Takes over the built-in web_search: 13 engines with automatic fallback, keyless by default, plus time filtering and platform search. It does not touch web_fetch.

zh.title: dsh-free-search（免费搜索）
zh.description: 接管内置 web_search：13 个引擎自动降级，默认免 API key，支持时间过滤与平台搜索。只负责搜索，不接管网页抓取。

en.title: dsh-web-fetch-playwright
en.description: Browser backend for web_fetch: real-browser rendering, then Readability denoising, returning Markdown. Fetch only — it is not a search provider.

zh.title: dsh-web-fetch-playwright（浏览器抓取）
zh.description: 为 web_fetch 提供浏览器后端：真实浏览器渲染后经 Readability 去噪返回 Markdown。只负责抓取，不是搜索提供方。

en.title: @linxin666/dsh-remote-web-ui
en.description: Scan-to-pair remote access that puts phones and PCs on one Web GUI, with one-time tokens, revocable device sessions, a LAN bind toggle and an optional Cloudflare tunnel.

zh.title: @linxin666/dsh-remote-web-ui（远程访问）
zh.description: 扫码把手机与电脑配对到同一个 Web GUI：一次性令牌、可撤销设备会话、局域网绑定开关与可选的 Cloudflare 隧道。

en.title: @furongjun1999/dsh-memory
en.description: Long-term memory and a knowledge flywheel: conversations settle into an md_cg cognitive graph, with self-model and recursive reflection. It injects memory context every turn.

zh.title: @furongjun1999/dsh-memory（灵枢记忆）
zh.description: 长期记忆与知识飞轮：对话自动沉淀为 md_cg 认知图，带自我认知与递归反思。会在每轮对话注入记忆上下文。

en.title: dsh-whale-widget
en.description: Corner widget showing DeepSeek balance, today's usage and peak/off-peak pricing, with customisable bubbles, characters and sound. Front-end display only.

zh.title: dsh-whale-widget（余额小鲸鱼）
zh.description: 右下角挂件：显示 DeepSeek 余额、今日用量与峰谷定价，可自定义气泡、角色与音效。纯前端展示，不参与对话。
